name: Outwrite Proud
source:
Every decision we make in those early years of adulthood, from the that we step out on our own, until the day we close that chapter of our lives, alters not just ourselves, but the community around us.

In Outwrite Proud, you take on the mantle of Marcus, a freshman at a small liberal arts college that just so happens to have a relatively new gay quarter down the street. The parts of Marcus he chooses to grow, be that through working in the gay quarter, doing homework, or spending time with friends, will define Marcus as a person, and, with time, reshape the very future of this small town’s queer community.
